entities.name: Tolaria West
entities.description: A small artificial island in the Spice Isles of Dominaria holding a campus of the Tolarian Academy.

entities.name: Tolarian Academy
entities.description: Academy of magic with several campuses including Tolaria West, Orvada and Lat-Nam.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: Group whose agent infiltrated Tolaria West.

entities.name: Weatherlight crew
entities.description: Crew who apprehended the Cabal agent.

entities.name: Society of Mishra
entities.description: Phyrexian group that took over Tolaria West in the Second Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Geyadrone Dihada
entities.description: Phyrexian who replaced the Archmage of Tolaria West.

entities.name: Linessa
entities.description: Became a member of Tolaria West's academy after the Time Spiral crisis.

entities.name: Vitha Thenwe
entities.description: Shield mage and Professor of Mathematics at the Academy.

entities.name: Naban
entities.description: Dean of Iteration at the Academy.

events.summary: Scholars found Tolaria West to honor legendary Tolaria, building a campus on an artificial island.
events.quote: Tolaria West was named by scholars of magic who wanted to honor legendary Tolaria

events.summary: A Cabal agent infiltrates the Academy, kills nine students, and is apprehended by the Weatherlight crew.
events.quote: killed nine students in the process with his dementia magic

events.summary: The Society of Mishra takes over Tolaria West, replacing staff with sleeper agents and the Archmage with Geyadrone Dihada.
After the war the campus is destroyed and many die, but the Academy recovers.
events.quote: the entire campus had been destroyed

relations.quote: The Academy at Tolaria West is just one of several campuses of the Tolarian Academy
